english.title: Found by constable in possession of game coming from land
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), on being searched by a constable in pursuance of section 2 of the Poaching Prevention Act 1862, were found in possession of game, namely **(..SPECIFY GAME..), which you had obtained by unlawfully going on land in search or pursuit of game
english.legislation: Contrary to section 2 of the Poaching Prevention Act 1862.
english.pointstoprove:

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: (i) 'Game' for the purpose of this offence is defined by Section 1 of the Act. It includes any one or more hares, pheasants, partridges, eggs of pheasants and partridges, woodcocks, snipes, rabbits, grouse, black or moor game, and eggs of grouse, black or moor game.
